The 'structural collapse' of the characters was correctly identified, but the `topology_boundary_auditor` mask shows a single fused blob, confirming this is a generation artifact rather than an artistic overlap. The background perspective distortion is minor compared to the text and fusion issues.
alignment_reasoning: The image fails the primary visual signifier of the class: readable title typography. The `fine_grained_classifier` ranked 'jigsaw puzzle' higher than 'comic book', indicating the model perceives the fragmented, nonsensical nature of the image over its semantic intent. While the glossy cover and general layout mimic a comic, the lack of coherent text and the fused character anatomy significantly degrade class conformance. It looks like a comic, but fails the functional definition of a printed periodical with legible metadata.
artifact_reasoning: Severe text gibberish (confirmed by OCR expert) and structural fusion of the central subjects (confirmed by topology mask) are the dominant artifacts. The text is not just blurry; it is pseudo-text, which breaks the realism of the object. The character fusion creates a biologically impossible entity that doesn't resolve into distinct figures even upon close inspection. These are high-severity structural and semantic artifacts.
